$comment: Stated values the watcher can read out of official documents. year_anchored extractors name the year in the sentence they match, so what they read holds for the whole year and autoupdate.py may apply a change (if every other rule holds). The rest are report-only: a difference is listed for a person with the exact line to change. Calibration excerpts are frozen from the real documents by `python watcher/extractors.py --refresh`; the tests check each pattern still reads its excerpt.

extractors.name: Illinois flat withholding rate
extractors.pattern: Effective January 1, {year}, Tax Rate (\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%

calibration.excerpt: Effective January 1, 2026, Tax Rate 4.95%

extractors.name: Michigan flat withholding rate
extractors.pattern: {year} Michigan Income Tax Withholding Guide Withholding Rate: (\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%

also.pattern: the rate in effect under Section 51 for the {year} tax year is (\d+(?:\.\d+)?)%

calibration.excerpt: 2026 Michigan Income Tax Withholding Guide Withholding Rate: 4.25%

extractors.name: Michigan personal exemption amount
extractors.pattern: {year} Michigan Income Tax Withholding Guide Withholding Rate: \d+(?:\.\d+)?% Personal Exemption Amount: \$([\d,]+)

calibration.excerpt: 2026 Michigan Income Tax Withholding Guide Withholding Rate: 4.25% Personal Exemption Amount: $5,900

extractors.name: Kentucky flat withholding rate
extractors.pattern: {year} Kentucky Tax Rate: (\d+(?:\.\d+)?)% of taxable income
